# gabarito-cone

> Gabarito Cone is a Python desktop tool (pywebview UI) for graphic designers that generates the flat pattern of a truncated cone as a 1:1 scale SVG. Enter top diameter, bottom diameter, height and an optional seam overlap in cm, and it draws the annular-sector label shape for conical cups, popcorn buckets and tumblers, then saves gabarito.svg for Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Inkscape, Affinity Designer or Figma.

## Files
- [gabarito_cone.py](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/gabarito-cone/blob/master/gabarito_cone.py): the whole app (embedded HTML UI, geometry, SVG output, save to Desktop)
- [README](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/gabarito-cone/blob/master/README.md): features, install, workflow, formulas, FAQ

## Key facts
- Run: `pip install pywebview` then `python gabarito_cone.py`
- Inputs (cm): top diameter, bottom diameter, height, seam overlap (margem de emenda)
- Output: SVG sized in mm at real scale, saved to ~/Desktop/gabarito.svg
- Shows outer radius, inner radius, sector angle, width, height and area in cm²
- Formulas: H = h·D/(D−d); S1 = √((D/2)²+H²); S2 = √((d/2)²+(H−h)²); θ = 360°·D/(2·S1)
- Equal top and bottom diameters produce a rectangle (cylinder)
- UI text is in Brazilian Portuguese
- Author: Wedny Fernandes (github.com/WednyFernandes)
